prompts.prometium: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution resource icon for the Dorbit space-game cargo trading menu. Generate a NEW original production-ready 3D-rendered mineral specimen. One single compact nugget only, centered in a square image, specimen occupies about 78 percent of canvas with comfortable transparent padding. Three-quarter view, consistent studio key light from upper left with subtle cool rim light; very sharp edges, physically detailed fractured mineral texture and small facets, clear readable silhouette at small icon sizes. High-resolution 1024x1024 or larger. Background must be genuinely transparent alpha, not a painted checkerboard. No opaque background, no colored square, no backdrop, no pedestal, no floor, no ground shadow, no frame, no labels, no text, no watermark, no floating particles, no diffuse bloom or blurry glow. Preserve crisp material detail, with controlled highlights that retain color and avoid blown-out white patches. Subject: a rough angular charcoal-black ore nugget with vivid red-orange mineral seams and emberlike crystalline inclusions; stone remains solid and cool, no flames.
